entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Hm? Are you that new transfer student[n]from Class D?

entries.en: Surprised you recognize me.

entries.en: You've got the wrong guy.
entries.uk: Ти мене з кимось сплутала.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Well, everyone has been talking[n]about you...

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Don't worry about the rumors though.[n]I'm sure they're just surprised for now.
entries.uk: Але не переймайся чутками.[n]Певна, усі поки що просто здивовані.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Huh? You don't need to lie.
entries.uk: Га? Не треба брехати.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: By the way, I don't mind what they say[n]in the rumors. I wouldn't believe that[n]stuff without proof.
entries.uk: До речі, мені байдуже, що кажуть[n]у чутках. Я б не повірила в таке[n]без доказів.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: ...A lot of people misunderstand my[n]best friend because of how she looks[n]too.
entries.uk: ...Мою найкращу подругу теж багато[n]хто розуміє хибно через її зовнішність.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: It's not good to assume you know[n]a person just by looking at them,[n]don't you think?

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Well, if you even need help, I'd be glad[n]to assist you.

entries.en: Where is the rooftop?

entries.en: Why are you hurt?

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Um... I'm okay though. Don't worry[n]about me.
entries.uk: Ем... Але зі мною все гаразд.[n]Не хвилюйся за мене.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: Well, sorry for stopping you so suddenly[n]here. I should be getting to practice, so...[n]see you around.
entries.uk: Що ж, вибач, що так раптово тебе[n]зупинила. Мені час на тренування,[n]тож... побачимося.

entries.speaker: Injured Female Student
entries.en: I have to hurry to practice... I'll be in[n]trouble if I don't get there on time.
